notes: Original script builds WORKX.BOUNDARY_COORDS and WORKX.POINTS_DF via cards4 DATA steps (kept byte-identical: same coordinates, validvarname=v7, id=_n_), then hands both off to PROC R (deldir/sf/ggplot2) to draw a Voronoi partition and PDF.
